description.value: Momo Sushi is a Japanese restaurant in Vancouver's historic Gastown neighbourhood on Water Street, offering a broad menu spanning sushi, sashimi, oshi, teriyaki, donburi, and Korean dishes in a fully licensed historic venue. The restaurant operates on a walk-in, first-come basis with no reservations and touts a waterfront view. Cyclists riding the nearby seawall or passing through Gastown will find it a convenient sit-down stop with online ordering and delivery also available.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 21m; rack (2 spaces) at 24m. Total: 4 spaces.
